title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to amending Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC) Section 4.61. Schedule…
text:
[Council File 26-1380]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to amending Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC) Section 4.61. Schedule "A" to provide a salary adjustment for the Executive Director, City Ethics Commission (Class Code 0013).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated September 11, 2026, approved as to form and legality by the City Attorney, amending Schedule “A” of Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 4.61, to provide a salary adjustment for the Executive Director, City Ethics Commission (Class Code 0013), as approved by the City Ethics Commission.
2. AUTHORIZE the City Administrative Officer (CAO), upon accretion of the class to a bargaining unit, to technically correct the appropriate Memorandum of Understanding to reflect the salaries approved by Ordinance.
3. AUTHORIZE the Controller and the CAO to correct any clerical or technical errors in the above Ordinance.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that the cost associated with adjusting the salary of the Executive Director, City Ethics Commission position will be absorbed within budgeted funds by the City Ethics Commission for Fiscal Year 2026-27.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted: the Ordinance for this item will be held over to November 13, 2026, for second reading (Nov 6, 2026); Council action final
